title: Yellowed Dense Syrian Eggplant Pilaf
description: A dense and savory Syrian dish featuring eggplant and chopped chives, perfect for midnight cravings. This ovo-vegetarian friendly pilaf is packed with umami flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped eggplant and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Add the uncooked white rice, stir to combine, and reduce heat to low.
Cover the saucepan and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the beaten eggs and cook until the eggs are set, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped chives and serve hot.
